test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is **"and."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Here** "**And (और; एवं, तथा, व)**" **is the correct word for the blank 3 as** 'and'** is used to connect two adjectives** "formal"** and **"intensive."**
 
• It also indicates a continuation or addition of information.
 
 
• **Example: ***She is bold **and**__ beautiful.*​
 
 
 
• The correct answer is option 1.
 
• Correct passage:

There are __times__ when everyone has to face grief. When someone dear to oneself dies, one is left in a state in which shock and grief __overcome__ ordinary life. One is left in a situation when one feels there is nothing one can do. Grief and mourning are not always associated with death. It also happens with other types of losses. It could be the loss of one’s job, loss of one’s house or the loss of a close friend or a partner. 

The best people who are able to cope with these are those, who come from cultures that have strict, formal __**and**__ intensive mourning rituals. In India, we have diverse rituals which nowadays are being discarded. But these help in the crisis. The near and dear ones come to share their grief and apply balm with their words of solace. In mourning, it is an essential part of coming ______ (4) ______ terms with loss. There comes a time when one has to give up one’s grief and rejoin the mainstream of life. Mourning in itself passes through these phases. Firstly, it is in the nature of shock and disbelief. A feeling of numbness overtakes me. The brain is not in a position to ______ (5) ______, it so happens that one expects the arrival of a loss thinking that nothing will change and he will be with the lost one. In the second phase, one realises the truth that the loss has actually happened, and was not a dream. It is now that one feels the pain. Now one recollects the old moments and the memory of guilt creeps in.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• The use of **"but (****किंतु, परंतु, लेकिन)****"** would imply a contrast or contradiction between the two clauses, which is not the intended meaning. 
 
• **"Or (****या अथवा (संभावनाओं या विकल्‍पों की सूची में प्रयुक्त))****"** would suggest a choice between two options, which is also not relevant in this context. 
 
• **"Also (साथ ही; भी)****"** would indicate an additional piece of information, but it would not connect the two clauses as effectively as "and".
